name: Mega Brown Box
tagline: Everyday goods, overstock & open-box finds at discount prices.
story: Mega Brown Box is an independent discount and overstock store in La Habra, California, owned and run by Mitch Rolam. It's Townshelf's first store and the model for how every shop lists, grades and ships.
quote: I want local shops to succeed and to compete with the big-box stores. That starts with my own shop.

name: Ridgeline Vintage Co.
story: A sample vintage shop tucked off a busy downtown block. June sorts every rack herself and only lists pieces she'd wear.
quote: Every jacket in here has already lived one good life. I just find it the next one.

name: Needle & Nickel Records
tagline: Crates dug, sleeves graded, needles dropped.
story: A sample neighborhood record store with a listening booth, a weekend crowd and a wall of staff picks.
quote: I grade every record like I'm buying it myself.

name: Tidewater Toy Loft
tagline: Wooden toys, puzzles and games for rainy harbor days.
story: A sample family-run toy shop above the harbor. Every game on the shelf gets a test play at the counter first.
quote: If our kids won't play with it, we don't stock it.

name: Fernhouse Plant Co.
tagline: Hardy houseplants and pots, packed to travel.
story: A sample corner plant shop in a restored brick storefront, known for hardy plants and pots thrown by local potters.
quote: We pack every plant like it's going to my grandmother.

name: Sagebrush Home Goods
tagline: Warm, useful things for the home.
story: A sample home goods shop that mixes new kitchenware with like-new lamps and textiles from estate buys.
quote: Good stuff should stay in homes, not landfills.

name: Live Oak Paper & Press
tagline: Letterpress cards, notebooks and pens under the oaks.
story: A sample stationery shop with a letterpress in the back room and a front window full of cards.
quote: People still love getting real mail. We help with that.
